# Medieval Christianity beyond Caricature Claim Audit

Support the primary activity for T5-L08 - Medieval Christianity beyond Caricature.

## Use
- Lesson: T5-L08 - Medieval Christianity beyond Caricature
- Big idea: The medieval period included corruption, coercion, reform, scholarship, service, and preservation and should not be reduced to one narrative.
- Primary reading: Matthew 23:1-12; selected historical evidence

## Evidence moves
1. Record direct observations.
2. Mark interpretation or canonical synthesis separately.
3. For historical claims, record the external source and confidence level.
4. State one faithful response without upgrading inference into explicit text.

## Publication hold
Do not publish post-biblical historical claims until the relevant primary/local source packet has been verified and cited.
